ambiguity_effects.explain: In Linear issues carry teamId while users have no team field, and the modifiers read in parallel as describing the issue. A careful colleague settles on issue-team, and both readings still leave the same three Maya Todo issues as the only c1-c2-c3 matches.

turn2.differences: No material difference. Author c1-c4 cover the Step 1 reading: exact assignee Maya Chen, state Todo, issue team Web, and parent project with three open issues in total.
turn2.naturalness_note: A real user would name the project. Identifying it only by counting exactly three open issues is a test hint, not natural reference.
